name: t4
title: Call of Duty: World at War (T4)
note: WaW (T4), 32-bit. The Steam CoDWaW.exe / CoDWaWmp.exe (1.7) are SteamStub-encrypted; CoDWaW LanFixed.exe (an older install's) is the same SP build unwrapped (.data identical, .rdata identical outside the rebuilt import table), flattened (file offset == RVA).
rva_note: read off CoDWaW LanFixed.exe: DB_LoadXFileData (dst eax, size ecx) the file read; Load_Stream 0x90310 (flag [esp+4], dst eax, size esi) is called from 54 places and inlined at the 207 other file reads; DB_PushStreamPos (eax: the block) and DB_PopStreamPos are real functions here (99 and 154 calls), each switching the block itself (no DB_SetStreamIndex as in CoD4); DB_InitStreams (eax: the XBlock table, 8 bytes per block); Load_XStringCustom reads a byte at a time (eax: the field); DB_InsertPointer 0x902e0 pushes 4, aligns 4, takes 4 bytes, pops

asset_dispatch.note: Load_XAsset: compares varXAsset->type and calls the type's Load_<T>Ptr with its var set to varXAssetHeader

stream.inline_stream_note: Load_Stream is inlined into most loaders (207 direct file reads) and push/pop are calls: the transcriber reads file_read as the read and folds the block index tests on the pushed block (reading_block 4 where the caller's decides)
stream.growing_blocks_note: the recording: blocks 4 (virtual) and 5 (large: vertex and index buffers) only grow over all 128 zones (3 347 715 and 160 reads); block 0 (temp) is rewound by every pop into it (212 348 of 259 669 reads below its previous end); 6 (physical) holds nothing
stream.null_page_note: DB_AddXAsset (0x8e300, engine code, skipped) returns 0 and the techset Ptr loader then writes through it (0x7ec0f: [eax + 8] = eax); a zero page takes such writes as on a pool slot

release.note: 2026-10-01: 128/128 zones identical (3 607 544 reads); check --jobs 4 in two size bands: 890 419/890 419 occurrences exact (the sampled count depends on --jobs and the banding; the threshold leaves room for it)
